mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYMENT ( order_id, payment_key, payment_method, payment_amount, payment_status, paid_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{paymentKey}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentAmount}, #{paymentStatus}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id, order_id, payment_key, payment_method, payment_amount, payment_status, paid_at, created_at FROM PAYMENT WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY payment_id DESC LIMIT 1
